description: ADO Command parameter values for the r-wire cells (read-write copy of r-wire-blank): per column an ADODB.Command INSERT INTO W (ID, column) VALUES (?, ?) with CreateParameter pI (adInteger) and pV (adUnsignedTinyInt, adSmallInt, adInteger, adSingle, adDouble, adCurrency, adDate, adVarWChar 255, adLongVarWChar, adVarBinary 255, adLongVarBinary, adBoolean for FByte..FBool), pV.Value = the cell's Arg (tags as in the DAO cells), Execute with adExecuteNoRecords; then the stored cells read per column with field metadata and GetRows(adGetRowsRest). Asks per cell the HRESULT and error and the stored tag and value.
